import sys,numpy as np

def xy(u,v): return np.array([.0135925-(v+.5)*mm,.1135925-(u+.5)*mm])
def path_samples(anchors, speed=.045, dt=.05):
    a=np.array(anchors,float); dense=[]; dep=[]
    for i in range(len(a)-1):
        p0=a[max(i-1,0),:2]; p1=a[i,:2]; p2=a[i+1,:2]; p3=a[min(i+2,len(a)-1),:2]
        for t in np.linspace(0,1,11,endpoint=False):
            c=.5*((2*p1)+(-p0+p2)*t+(2*p0-5*p1+4*p2-p3)*t*t+(-p0+3*p1-3*p2+p3)*t*t*t)
            dense.append(c); dep.append(a[i,2]*(1-t)+a[i+1,2]*t)
    dense.append(a[-1,:2]); dep.append(a[-1,2])
    wp=np.array([xy(p[0],p[1]) for p in dense]); dep=np.array(dep)
    ds=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(wp,axis=0),axis=1))]
    samples=np.arange(0,ds[-1],speed*dt)
